explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/785: Chen–Fang [ChFa15] proved that A(x)B(x) − x ≪ A(x)^c cannot hold for any c > 0. The statement uses min(A(x), B(x))^c, which the docstring attributes to ChFa15. It coincides with the page's form when A is the sparser set (which, by Narkiewicz, is eventually the minimum). Faithful.
